messages:
Sabrina Hall: quick follow-up thread for NovaHealth on-prem peering incident. Pulled out action items from the postmortem call. Please ack and add missing items.

Tim Chen: ack. saw repeated route withdrawals around 02:12 UTC, correlates with their edge link flapping.

Kevin Park: +1. Suspect MTU/fragmentation + a race in our vpc-peering agent that leaves stale NLRI.

Maria Gomez: customer wants ETA and proof we won't reintroduce leakage. they asked for a config preflight before we roll.

Sabrina Hall: action items (owner / ETA):
- A1: Lab reproduction & deterministic script (Tim) - EOD Tue (1934765301)
- A2: Alert + runbook for asymmetric peering (Kevin) - PR by Fri
- A3: Customer preflight checklist + comms draft (Maria) - draft tomorrow
- A4: Hotfix to force eviction on session teardown (eng-runtime owner TBD) - target next week
- A5: Post-deploy smoke tests (oncall-ops) - include BGP flapping + route reconciliation checks

Tim Chen: starting lab repro. I captured the pcap and will replay: ```
tcpreplay -i eth0 capture_nova.pcap
```
Prelim note: when injecting 9000-byte frames to peer with MTU 1500 we observe NLRI withdraws then session reset ~40s after. Keepalive tweak delays reset.

Kevin Park: for A2 I'll create ticket and alert: vpc_peering.asymmetry_detected tags:customer:NovaHealth severity:warning. Runbook steps: 1) verify BGP neigh 2) check MTU mismatch 3) clear stale cached prefixes 4) escalate to eng-runtime if eviction failures.

oncall-ops: added A5 to this week's rotation. I'll run smoke once hotfix candidate is staged.

Sabrina Hall: on the isolation bug we saw eviction race on teardown during concurrent reconcile. Repro notes in ticket: https://internal/repo/issue/5462 (customer link).

Kevin Park: can we land a synchronous eviction stub as temporary mitigation? if yes I'll approve hotfix.

Tim Chen: I can validate hotfix in lab and run smoke tests. Tagging hotfix:candidate. Smoke tests: BGP flapping, nlri presence, packet path sanity.

Maria Gomez: drafting customer note with timeline + rollback plan + lab artifacts. Will post to #customer-comms for review.

incident-bot: Incident recorded: incident-2026-03-22-novahealth-peering — SLA impacted: 22m degraded throughput.

Sabrina Hall: blockers?

Kevin Park: need eng-runtime owner for A4. Tim can you triage and nominate?

Tim Chen: I'll lead triage. Nominate Josh Rivera and Anya Patel for runtime patch.

oncall-ops: owners recorded in tracker: A1:Tim, A2:Kevin, A3:Maria, A4:Tim -> runtime engs, A5:oncall-ops. ETA summary added.

Sabrina Hall: please post 1-line status updates here when your item is complete so we can close the customer ticket. :thumbsup:

Kevin Park: will post PR link when A2 merges.

Tim Chen: lab repro complete, logs uploaded: https://ci.internal/artifacts/nova-peering-repro/1934678901. moving to hotfix testing.

Maria Gomez: customer comms draft posted for review.

incident-bot: Reminder: follow-up review scheduled in 7 days.
